head: 985e5faf7b6d2ae360f3c5759627835b9a1831d1
title: Audit trivia: fifteen reviewed corrections and independent UTC reviews
body:
Fifteen original trivia questions now have independently reviewed corrections. Current source: `985e5faf7b6d2ae360f3c5759627835b9a1831d1`. Original Ready PR #22 remains unchanged and unmerged.

The checker now rejects missing/self-review identities, role/case aliases, and malformed, future, naive or non-UTC review dates. All three original controls remain, with twelve additional controls. Rendering preserves the original shuffle, sources and continuation evidence.

Five separately published substantive post-green reviews have qualified: Duke Ellington wording, the Mount Fuji city clue, two named-answer clues, the Arches park-name clue, and two scientific terminology clues. The latest stems ask about a named SI unit relative to 273.15 K and the alcohol-to-vinegar conversion. Full fresh source context and separate post-author factual reviews support both; a newly dated independent assessment recomputed all 1,000 row hashes and 4,000 option lengths. All original difficulty levels and correct indices remain exact; 985 other original objects and 994 original option arrays remain unchanged. All current options are identical to the accepted thirteen-correction source.

Validation: original run [37948299244](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-gpt-drops/actions/runs/37948299244), job 113880220864, all ten original steps passed. I read the whole native log and verified all 338 manifest entries against physical files. Whole native proof: 53,758 bytes, SHA256 `b3c4f26721990a33af7fc06283ca1423af537d2d9474748260ce78f48d7bedb8`. Hosted artifacts are actually empty; private body support comes from the complete local checks: 1,000 rows, 560 source records, 3,510 author and 3,510 independent-reopen matches, 4,000 option associations, all 2,205 current similarity flags resolved, fifteen checker fixtures and six original adapter controls. Report SHA256 `aa4c9f99aa2753a420f0432742974b4c7d82e516921a517437bf348d233233cc`.

The original local checker passed at 14:57:39.759135 UTC. A private publication helper then failed because it expected an older 2,210-flag count; the actual changed stems yield 2,205. The original passed report and failed helper are preserved. Only that private expectation was corrected, with no production gate weakened or original check repeated. The 14:59 documentation time is a rendering time, not another checker execution.

Actual source publication was 14:59:14.104041 UTC: 4.680839 seconds beyond the 30-minute deadline and 304.680839 seconds beyond the 25-minute target. Those misses are retained.

Draft: the next original-check rerun, personally ranked review and decision that remaining improvements are only cosmetic are still pending. The original optional PartyBox adapter covers 51 static rows; no whole-bank port or human playtest is claimed. Research licenses and cumulative canonical quotation limits remain recorded.
